vat.summary: Irish VAT (TVA/CBL). Standard rate has been 23% for years — confirm on revenue.ie before quoting.

facts.note: Not HMRC. A UK VAT number is not an Irish one.

payroll.summary: Irish payroll is PAYE under Revenue, with USC and PRSI as well as income tax. Use the Irish payroll product, not a UK PAYE table.

facts.note: Three deductions, not one. Read the books.
